description: Curated US-market discovery watchlist. All symbols map to US exchanges listed by India INX Global Access, but individual instrument availability is not verified.
eligibility_policy: All rows are unverified research candidates. Move a symbol to data/zerodha_us_universe.json and set zerodha_eligible=true only after checking it in the user's Kite Global Stocks account.
